answer: An hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The reef schedule is applied in dawn and wander publishes each instalment. A payout is split thus 29% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1736 identities would post 1444 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
